ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, estimated at less than 5% of the total ventral area, primarily appearing as isolated specular highlights or small punctate marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface exhibits a mostly uniform low-intensity dark pigmentation. No large-scale contiguous high-contrast geometric blobs or mottling patterns are present. High-contrast mapping is limited to fine-grained white speckling scattered across the central and right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending approximately 10% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire span. Peaks and valleys range from 2 to 12 pixels in amplitude. A significant, deep irregular indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately 15 pixels from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering from the wide central base towards sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-6 pixel diameter) are detected, with higher concentration on the inner right lobe and near the junction of the peduncle.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent linear disruption is visible on the mid-left lobe, oriented diagonally from the top-left toward the center-right. Several shorter, less distinct linear marks are distributed across the lower half of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged serration and irregular chipping along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant missing segment or notch on the proximal inner margin of the right lobe. Numerous small circular scars distributed across the ventral fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical and non-uniform trailing edge topography, characterized by extreme jaggedness compared to standard species morphological priors.
